requirement: EPIC 1 Story 1 — author and select four independent note-only pattern slots while keeping global sound profiles and full-bank persistence intact.
story: Net tracker: EPIC 1 #1 — Author/select four slots (High, Priority 2).

architecture.decision: usePatternBank owns the four Pattern values, activeSlot, queuedSlot, and activePatternRef. usePattern retains guide state and routes every note/grid/live-input mutation through commitActiveSlot. The existing BeatDocument bridge persists only slot notes; runtime drum/bass banks remain global and are mirrored across in-memory slot values without entering the document.
alternatives: Keep pattern state in usePattern and hold slots in persistence: rejected because audio, grid, and mutation ownership would split across hooks.
Switch the grid in the visual onStep callback: rejected because the audio subscriber reads the old pattern first at the loop boundary.
tradeoffs: Pattern keeps its existing runtime bank fields for compatibility with audio callers, while document serialization continues to strip them from slots.
Queued selection is visible immediately but active state changes only when commitQueuedSlot runs at step 0.
seams: useTransportEngine calls bank.commitQueuedSlot() as the first operation inside onStepAudio when s === 0.
Hydration replaces all four bank slots before autosave is enabled; active slot starts at 1 because active slot is not part of BeatDocument.
Slot selection is rejected while guidance is not in compose status; accepted non-lesson selection resets ephemeral guidance.

tasks.title: Create the four-slot pattern bank hook
tasks.intent: Own four independent in-memory Pattern slots, active/queued selection, activePatternRef, active-slot edits, full-bank replacement, and global runtime sound-bank updates.
tasks.constraints: Use existing Pattern and immutable helpers; no Context/store/dependency; keep the active ref synchronous for the audio callback; latest queued slot wins; slots begin empty; preserve global drum/bass bank behavior without serializing banks.
tasks.acceptance: The hook exposes PatternSlot, activePattern, patterns, activeSlot, queuedSlot, activePatternRef, commitActiveSlot, selectSlot, commitQueuedSlot, replacePatternBank, and setGlobalBank. Edits affect only the active slot; stopped selection updates immediately; playing selection only queues; commitQueuedSlot swaps the ref/state and clears the queue; global bank changes are shared by all slots.
tasks.result: Created usePatternBank with four empty slots, synchronous activePatternRef, active edits, stopped/immediate selection, latest-wins queued selection, loop-boundary commit, full-bank replacement, and global runtime bank mirroring.

tasks.title: Route editing, transport, and persistence through the bank
tasks.intent: Remove pattern ownership from usePattern, connect all existing mutation paths and live audio refs to the bank, commit queued selection in the audio boundary, and persist all four slots.
tasks.constraints: Preserve guide gating and reset behavior; do not add a second audio engine; document shape stays unchanged; hydration must precede autosave; commitQueuedSlot must run before reading patternRef.current.
tasks.acceptance: Grid, live input, guidance, audio scheduling, import/reset, export, and autosave all use the bank; currentDocument includes all four slots; no heldSlots/setPattern bridge remains; TypeScript/build are green.
tasks.result: usePattern now keeps guidance while routing edits to usePatternBank; persistence serializes all four slots; transport commits queued slots at audio step 0 before reading patternRef; import/reset/hydration replace the full bank.
evidence: rg confirms no heldSlots bridge or setPattern caller remains

tasks.title: Add accessible four-slot controls
tasks.intent: Expose active and queued pattern slots in the score UI with clear state, keyboard access, and stable existing layout behavior.
tasks.constraints: Use existing visual tokens and button conventions; active slot is distinct from queued slot; controls remain usable while playing; guidance lock is communicated accessibly; no layout shift in the grid.
tasks.acceptance: Four named slot buttons are visible and keyboard-operable; stopped selection changes active slot/grid immediately; playing selection shows queued state without changing the grid until the boundary; rapid selection leaves only the latest queued slot selected.
tasks.visual: Run the app and inspect stopped selection, playing queue state, rapid 2→3→4 selection, focus states, and no score/grid shift.
tasks.result: Added PatternSlots with four keyboard-operable buttons, active/queued state, live status text, and guidance-disabled behavior; integrated it into the score header without shifting the grid.
evidence: Browser DOM snapshot and screenshot show the four-slot control group and active slot state

tasks.title: Verify four-slot authoring and boundary behavior
tasks.intent: Prove independent slot notes, full-bank persistence, latest-wins queued selection, and audio/grid/active synchronization in the running app.
tasks.constraints: Manual/visual gate plus build; use the existing dev server and browser storage; do not claim an audio gate without starting transport and hearing the boundary swap.
tasks.acceptance: Slots 2–4 start empty; edits remain isolated; refresh restores notes in multiple slots; stopped selection is immediate; while playing 2→3→4 activates only 4 at the next step-0 boundary with audio/grid/active state together; no console errors.
tasks.visual: Run the dev server, edit distinct cells in slots 1–4, reload, select while stopped, then play and exercise rapid queued selection at the loop boundary. Save screenshot/evidence path if available.
tasks.result: Browser acceptance passed: slots 2 and 3 held distinct kick notes; refresh restored both; clean playback run started transport, accepted rapid 2→3→4 selection, and activated slot 4 at the loop boundary; playback stopped cleanly with zero console errors.
evidence: Browser: slot2Step1=true and slot3Step2=true after reload
